title: InstaJudge: Aligning Judgment Bias of LLM-as-Judge with Humans in Industry Applications

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3: "Throughout the experiments, gpt-4o-2024-05-13 was used as the backbone LLM [for judging]. Performance was measured using 5-fold cross-validation..."

claim.metric: F1-score / Pearson correlation vs. business-defined labels

data.source: Proprietary industrial datasets (Customer Chatbot Conversation, Customer Issue, GenAI, SearchQA); Table 4 additionally uses the public JudgeBench (Tan et al. 2025)

notes: gpt-4o-2024-05-13 plays the LLM-as-judge role throughout (role A), including on the public JudgeBench table, so it never has an S/B-role capability claim of its own; the paper's main Table 3 results additionally depend on closed business datasets.
